name: [DEV ONLY - READ ONLY] AGE 03 - Chatwoot Recipient Message Evidence Page (No Writes)

parameters.query:
-- AGE 03 manual read-only recipient page, account scope+WhatsApp inbox.
-- Query is parameterized: never interpolate destination or cursor into SQL.
-- Scope is current Chatwoot snapshots, NOT Meta event log or AGE attempt history.
SELECT c.account_id, c.id AS internal_campaign_id,
       c.display_id AS campaign_display_id, c.title AS campaign_name,
       c.inbox_id,
       cr.id AS recipient_row_id, cr.contact_id,
       cr.contact_inbox_id, ct.phone_number AS current_mobile_number,
       cr.source_id AS provider_message_id, cr.status AS message_status,
       cr.sent_at, cr.delivered_at, cr.read_at, cr.failed_at,
       cr.error_code, cr.error_title, cr.error_message,
       cr.updated_at AS recipient_updated_at
FROM campaign_recipients cr
JOIN campaigns c ON c.id=cr.campaign_id AND c.account_id=cr.account_id
JOIN inboxes i ON i.id=c.inbox_id AND i.account_id=c.account_id
  AND i.channel_type='Channel::Whatsapp'
LEFT JOIN contacts ct ON ct.id=cr.contact_id AND ct.account_id=cr.account_id
WHERE c.account_id=$1::bigint AND c.campaign_type=1
  AND (cr.updated_at,cr.id) > ($2::timestamp,$3::bigint)
ORDER BY cr.updated_at ASC,cr.id ASC
LIMIT ($4::integer+1);
